not_covered: New initial orientations, weakened actuators, terrain or impacts
Robot self-collision response or continuous-time path clearance
qualification_economy: Reuse the native owner, capture, shared reader and retained-path diagnostic. Twenty controls cover the optional support-exchange interface, analytic hinge geometry, unchanged guards, atomic state, balanced assignment, fresh references and required route coverage. No new physical owner or native reader.
purpose: Search 18 factored support-exchange recipes across 24 exposed bodies with fresh comparators and retained failures.
selection_rationale: Eighteen parameter recipes cross three replacement-limb relations, three geometric mass-shift weights and two plateau windows. Each body receives six recipes around its selected exposed reference plus three fresh comparators. Every recipe covers four bodies in each geometric stratum. Forty-eight instantiated exchange profiles reuse eight distinct references; all 58 concrete profiles are assigned. The body-specific reference is exposed design input, not learned or held-out selection. Reference-block assignment is a finite screening design, not an estimate of independent population-wide factor effects.
braking_model_limit: Constant-velocity lookahead and a stopping-speed envelope using a declared 6 rad/s^2 shaping estimate. This is not a validated physical deceleration bound or a guarantee that no joint crosses its limit.
body_moment_limit: Clear geometric targets are not collision-free transitions. Geometric capsule low points are not measured contact locations. Friction cones and normal load are configured proposals; static joint compensation omits inertial, Coriolis, passive and limit forces. Actual force, contact and sampled work are retained. Motors, native collision filtering and eligibility remain unchanged.
code_path_risks_covered: Exact reference behavior until measured plateau
Retained original contact forces while only an unloaded limb seeks replacement
Nine declared knee samples and analytic hip-height roots with a 0.05 rad joint margin
Measured replacement contact dwell before only the old primary limb retracts
No-clear-target or bounded-timeout reference fallback, with cooldown
Full replay and same-run compact projection on one exposed route body
Synthetic atomic memory, upright reset, unchanged joint guards and fresh-reference screen
Prospectively required full retained-sample path screen before promoting broad-search leads
route_horizon_rationale: Six seconds permits reference acquisition and plateau detection, a 180-step search, six consecutive contact observations and a 36-step transfer, plus reference fallback. Twelve roles cover three fresh comparators and nine variants spanning all limb relations, mass-shift weights and both plateau windows. At least one supported seek, measured contact acquisition, transfer and no-clear-target or timeout fallback must be observed; failure consumes the route and blocks compact search.
support_exchange_limit: Requested support forces are model proposals, not measured contact loads. Floor-intersection targets preserve other measured joints exactly and reject overlapping endpoints, but do not establish feasible or collision-free motion. Mass-shift weighting is a geometric score, not a learned value. Original native collision filtering, motor force bounds, joint protection, five-degree reference-gain rule and recovery eligibility are unchanged.
